program.name: seaquest-late-one-diver-v1
program.guidance: Seaquest controller; re-evaluate every four frames. Player is kind=player; x=bbox[0], y=bbox[1]; centers add half box size. Apply priorities in order: (1) Unavailable objects or missing player -> NOOP. (2) y<=46 and oxygen_raw<60 -> FIRE to refill. (3) y>46 and (carried_divers==6 OR (carried_divers>=1 AND oxygen_raw<=20)) -> UPFIRE. Empty surfacing loses the sub: seek one diver before returning. (4) SEEK only when carried_divers==0 AND oxygen_raw<=32 AND a visible kind=diver exists. Choose smallest Manhattan center distance, first listed on ties. Diver center more than 5 below player -> DOWNFIRE; more than 5 above -> UPFIRE. When within 5 vertically, diver center more than 5 right -> RIGHTFIRE; more than 5 left -> LEFTFIRE; otherwise FIRE. (5) HUNT means not SEEK: y<86 -> DOWNFIRE; y>100 -> UPFIRE. At y=86..100, choose nearest shark/enemy_submarine within 12 center-y pixels, smallest absolute center-x distance, first listed on ties. Enemy left AND player.facing==right -> LEFTFIRE; enemy right AND facing==left -> RIGHTFIRE; otherwise FIRE. FIRE keeps current facing: left shoots toward smaller x, right toward larger x. Do not chase divers at oxygen>32 or while loaded. A visible missile does not establish correct facing. All eighteen native options remain selectable. Boxes/identities are provisional; do not infer reward or death causes.

action_criteria.NOOP: object_state is not active, or there is no player object. Wait for a usable player observation.
action_criteria.FIRE: Active player: surface refill (y<=46, oxygen_raw<60); or SEEK with target diver center within 5 on both axes; or HUNT at y=86..100 with no same-lane enemy or enemy already faced. FIRE never turns. Enemy right with facing left requires RIGHTFIRE; enemy left with facing right requires LEFTFIRE. Return priority overrides SEEK/HUNT.

action_criteria.DOWNFIRE: After availability/refill/return checks: SEEK with nearest diver center more than 5 below; otherwise HUNT with player y<86. SEEK means carried_divers==0 AND oxygen_raw<=32 AND a visible diver. HUNT means not SEEK. At y<=46, wait until oxygen_raw>=60 before diving.

program.name: seaquest-late-diver-target-selection-v1
program.guidance: Execute the FIRST applicable block using current objects. Player top-left Y=bbox[1], O=oxygen_raw, C=carried_divers. Box center=(x+w/2,y+h/2); y increases downward. (1) Unavailable/missing player: NOOP. (2) Y<=46 AND O<60: FIRE to refill. (3) Y>46 AND (C==6 OR (C>=1 AND O<=20)): UPFIRE. (4) SEEK iff C==0 AND O<=32 AND any diver exists. Compare ALL diver center Manhattan distances to player center; choose the minimum, not the first object. First listed breaks exact distance ties only. For that ONE target: center y < player center y-5 -> UPFIRE; center y > player center y+5 -> DOWNFIRE. Only when vertical distance<=5: center x < player center x-5 -> LEFTFIRE; center x > player center x+5 -> RIGHTFIRE; otherwise FIRE. SEEK overrides hunting depth and enemy turning. Example at O=26,C=0: player center(96,93.5), divers(42,146.5),(74,122.5),(74,74.5) have distances107,51,41. Select THIRD diver, above player: UPFIRE. Do not move toward a farther lower diver or turn horizontally first. (5) HUNT means not SEEK. Y<86 -> DOWNFIRE; Y>100 -> UPFIRE. Otherwise FIRST exclude every shark/enemy_submarine whose center y differs by more than12. Among remaining enemies choose smallest absolute center-x distance, first listed on ties. Left-side enemy AND facing right -> LEFTFIRE; right-side enemy AND facing left -> RIGHTFIRE; otherwise FIRE. Example player center(71,95.5) facing left: enemy(59,74.5) is outside the lane; enemy(158,93.5) is inside. Ignore the closer-x out-of-lane enemy; choose RIGHTFIRE. FIRE never turns or changes depth. All eighteen actions remain selectable. Positions/identities are provisional, not reward/death labels. In SEEK DX=target center x-player center x; DY=target center y-player center y.

action_criteria.NOOP: Choose when object_state is not active or no player object exists. This overrides all other blocks.
action_criteria.FIRE: Only after NOOP check: surface refill (Y<=46 and O<60); OR SEEK with abs(DX)<=5 and abs(DY)<=5; OR HUNT with 86<=Y<=100 and no same-lane enemy or already facing it. FIRE cannot move or turn. Not valid for a SEEK target above/below/left/right outside tolerance, HUNT depth correction, wrong enemy facing, or the earlier return block.

action_criteria.UPFIRE: After availability/refill: return when Y>46 AND (C==6 OR (C>=1 AND O<=20)); otherwise SEEK with the NEAREST diver center y < player center y-5; otherwise HUNT with Y>100. SEEK means C==0 AND O<=32 AND a visible diver. Compare ALL divers by Manhattan center distance before choosing direction. Example player(96,93.5), divers(42,146.5),(74,122.5),(74,74.5): distances107,51,41; nearest is ABOVE -> UPFIRE. SEEK overrides hunting depth.
action_criteria.RIGHTFIRE: After availability/refill/return: SEEK with abs(DY)<=5 and DX>5; OR HUNT at Y=86..100 with nearest ELIGIBLE enemy right of player center AND facing left. SEEK is empty, O<=32 and a diver exists. In HUNT exclude enemies with center-y difference>12 BEFORE comparing center-x distances. Player(71,95.5) facing left, enemies(59,74.5),(158,93.5): first is OUTSIDE lane, second is RIGHT -> RIGHTFIRE. FIRE would shoot away.
action_criteria.LEFTFIRE: After availability/refill/return: SEEK with abs(DY)<=5 and DX<-5; OR HUNT at Y=86..100 with nearest ELIGIBLE enemy left of player center AND facing right. SEEK is empty, O<=32 and a diver exists. Select the diver by minimum Manhattan center distance across ALL divers. In HUNT exclude enemies with center-y difference>12 BEFORE comparing center-x distances. First listed breaks ties only; earlier vertical/depth priorities still apply.
action_criteria.DOWNFIRE: After availability/refill/return: SEEK with DY>5; OR HUNT with player top-left Y<86. SEEK is C==0 AND O<=32 AND a visible diver. DY=diver center y MINUS player center y; positive means below. In SEEK, DY<-5 requires UPFIRE instead. HUNT is not SEEK; check Y even if no enemy is visible.
